Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lots as a glowing pickup at the treasure part, such as an item corpse or a chest. Taking it awards the lots and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears. A chest treasure starts disabled and becomes available when the chest is opened. The item lot slots come in pairs; only the first pair's second slot (Secondary Item Lot) is used in retail.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Object (item corpse, chest). For a chest, this is the chest object that is opened. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLot1.Wiki: The main ItemLotParam row given by the treasure. Set on every retail treasure.

SecondaryItemLot.Wiki: An alternative ItemLotParam row paired with Item Lot 1, used together with Secondary Item Lot Flag (Chalice Dungeon treasures). 0 or -1 for none.

ItemLot2.Wiki: A second ItemLotParam row given with the first. Rarely used; 0 or -1 for none.

UnkT1C.Wiki: The paired slot after Item Lot 2. 0 or -1 on every retail treasure.

ItemLot3.Wiki: A third ItemLotParam row given with the first. Rarely used; 0 or -1 for none.

UnkT24.Wiki: The paired slot after Item Lot 3. 0 or -1 on every retail treasure.

ItemLot4.Wiki: A fourth ItemLotParam row given with the first. Rarely used; 0 or -1 for none.

UnkT2C.Wiki: The paired slot after Item Lot 4. 0 or -1 on every retail treasure.

ItemLot5.Wiki: A fifth item lot slot, by the layout of the others. 0 or -1 on every retail treasure.

UnkT34.Wiki: The paired slot after Item Lot 5. 0 or -1 on every retail treasure.

ActionButtonID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for the pickup prompt, or -1 for the default. Retail sets it on chest treasures (7200 to 7231).

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The player animation played when taking the pickup, or -1 for the normal one. Named from the same field in later games; -1 on every retail treasure.

InChest.Wiki: If ON, the item is inside a chest. In retail it is always used together with Start Disabled, so the item can only be taken after the chest is opened.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it, such as the chest opening. Turn it off for items that should be available at once.

SecondaryItemLotFlagID.Wiki: An event flag tied to Secondary Item Lot: when it is ON, the secondary lot is given instead. -1 for none. Set only on treasures that use a secondary lot.

UnkT48.Wiki: Unknown. 0 on treasures that use Secondary Item Lot, else -1.
